title: Erasmus Mundus Application and Beyond
subtitle: From Application, Acceptance to Life Across Europe
description: Erasmus Mundus doesn’t end with an acceptance letter. Get an insider’s look at what happens next, from preparing to leave Bangladesh and navigating multiple universities to studying, moving across Europe, and experiencing the real Erasmus journey firsthand.
mentorHeading: Learn from someone who has already done it.
mentorBio: Hi, I’m Mohsina - an Erasmus Mundus Scholar who studied across Belgium and Spain at Ghent University, UB, UAB, and UPC. Soon to be starting my PhD journey at University of Aberdeen, Scotland.

I’ve been through the full study-abroad journey on my own , shortlisting universities, writing motivation letters, applying for scholarships, handling visas, relocating across countries, and adapting to completely new academic systems and cultures. I know how confusing, overwhelming, and stressful this process can feel because I’ve lived it.

I’m very detail-oriented when it comes to applications. I know what makes a motivation letter stand out, how to structure a strong CV, and how to plan a smart scholarship strategy, especially for Erasmus Mundus and other funded programs. I can also guide you through visa steps, relocation planning, and what it’s really like to study and live in Europe as an international student.
If you want practical guidance, honest feedback, and someone who will help you stay organised, confident, and on track, I’m here to help you make your application clear, strong, and hard to ignore!
